gloss: year-round; all year; throughout the year

definitions.gloss: year-round; all year; throughout the year
definitions.explanation: Spanning or available throughout the entire year, not limited to a particular season. Often used as an adverbial modifier.

examples.japanese: このプールは{通年|つうねん}{営業|えいぎょう}している。
{沖縄|おきなわ}では{通年|つうねん}で{温暖|おんだん}な{気候|きこう}が{続|つづ}く。
examples.english: Okinawa enjoys a warm climate throughout the year.

examples.japanese: この{農園|のうえん}は{通年|つうねん}で{様々|さまざま}な{野菜|やさい}を{栽培|さいばい}しており、{季節|きせつ}を{問|と}わず{出荷|しゅっか}できる。
examples.english: This farm grows various vegetables year-round and can ship regardless of the season.

notes:
Used to indicate that something continues or is available throughout all four seasons. Typically modifies a noun or verb phrase.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通年|つうねん}{営業|えいぎょう} (open year-round)
- {通年|つうねん}{採用|さいよう} (year-round hiring)
- {通年|つうねん}で{利用|りよう}できる (available year-round)

Contrasts with {季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい} (seasonal/limited to a season). Commonly appears in business, tourism, and agriculture contexts.
